originalRequest:
Forget the mobile view. 
Look only the desktop view.

Make it look luxury
subject: Overnight Ring Studio: a guided engagement ring configurator where shoppers choose a setting, customise it, pick a diamond, then review and order
scope: A desktop-only visual redesign of the existing single-file configurator (/Users/ashley/Documents/om3/index.html). Mobile layout is out of scope. The current flow, data and interactions stay the same.
primaryGoal: Make the desktop configurator look and feel like a high-end fine-jewellery atelier, so shoppers trust it and go on to choose a diamond and order
audience: Couples shopping for an engagement ring online on desktop. They care about craftsmanship and confidence in a big purchase.
offer: Design your own signature ring: pick from 10 setting styles, customise metal, width, size, prongs, finish and engraving, choose a lab or natural diamond, and view it in 360°
primaryAction: Continue to Diamond, then complete the ring and order
creativeControl: High freedom over visual styling (type scale, spacing, colour refinement, surfaces, motion) while keeping the brand identity and functional flow
requiredContent: Header: Overnight logo, Ring Studio label, appointment, recently viewed and saved-designs icons
Intro: 'Create your own signature' headline with a short subtitle
Step 1, Choose your setting: Get Inspired trending picks (The Aurelia, The Etta, The Elise, See all trending), Surprise me, and a grid of 10 styles with prices
Setting customisation: 8 variants per style plus metal, purity, width, size, prongs, finish and engraving controls
Step 2, Choose your diamond: lab/natural toggle, shape grid, carat, price, cut, colour and clarity filters, sortable diamond list with match count
Step 3, Review: summary of setting and diamond with total price and order action
Sticky ring canvas: large photo stage with thumbnail views, 360° video, heart and share buttons, collapse button
Your Ring panel: style number, specs strip (setting, metal, width, size, prongs, diamond), setting price, View details and Continue to Diamond
Condensed sticky step bar with the step tracker
Overlays: ring detail view, trending modal, saved-designs compare table, recently viewed popover, toasts
constraints: Desktop only (at least 1100px wide); do not redesign mobile
Keep the existing single-file HTML/CSS/JS structure, element IDs and JS behaviour
Keep the existing product photos in assets/settings and the 360 videos in 'ring vids'
Animations should be restrained transitions for steps, filters, selection, drawers and the canvas, and must honour prefers-reduced-motion
No invented testimonials, credentials or claims
brandInputs: Logo: assets/overnight-logo.png (navy OVERNIGHT wordmark), from the existing page
Colours: warm ivory/pearl background, deep navy/midnight panel with gradient, champagne-gold metallic accents and button gradient, from the existing CSS variables
Typography: high-contrast serif display (Cormorant-style) for headlines and a clean sans for UI text, from the existing page
Visual style: soft radial pearl gradients behind ring photos, hairline dividers, small uppercase letter-spaced labels, from the existing 'Version 2 luxury visual layer'
assumptions: 'Make it look luxury' means elevating the existing desktop visual layer, not changing the product flow
Configurator interface, so classed as a dashboard-type product screen, with no marketing sections added
Mobile CSS is left as it is
Earlier review bugs (price filter, 360 fallback, share) are not part of this styling brief unless they affect the visuals
unresolved: Whether the 7 styles without a 360 video should hide the 360 control
